author: mjackson

title: doctor --fix can follow symlinks and write outside the app root
author: mjackson

author: markmals
body_preview: A `<Frame>` that is the first child of a bare `<Fragment>` (`<>`) returned by a `clientEntry` fails to adopt its server-rendered frame markers during hydration.
